sentences.en: He's horribly disfigured as if acid has eaten his flesh.
sentences.zh: 他被严重毁容，好像有人用酸液腐蚀了他的皮肤。

sentences.en: "Yanni hit Skura and disfigured her." "This man in a monster."
sentences.zh: "Yanni袭击了Skura并使她变得面目全非。" "这个人就像个怪物。"

sentences.en: Yanni went to great lengths to disfigure Skura's body.
sentences.zh: Yanni费尽心思让Skura的身体变得面目全非。

senses.zh: 使变丑；损毁……的外形；使大为减色
